provenance.procedure: GET /configuration with a bad token; synthesised from the TMDB v3 contract (ADR-0026).
provenance.note: Synthesised: TMDB answers a rejected token with HTTP 401 and a JSON status body (status_code 7). Used via Exchange.ServeOne so the status, not the routing, is the subject — it shares method+path with the happy-path configuration fixture.

response.body: {"success":false,"status_code":7,"status_message":"Invalid API key: You must be granted a valid key."}
